name: Doki Doki Xintiao Huangmu zhuang
source:
Kira had a bizarre dream. In the dream, he and everyone else from the Arakisou attend in a high school literature club named "Arakisou." There is the tsundere Dio; the genius scientist, Kars; the childhood BFF, Doppio; No.1 Dio fans, Pucci; the literature club president, Valentine; the wild Diego; and the mysterious student, Toru. As the story started to get out of control, will Kira be able to escape this dream?

A fan made game of Jojo Bizarre Adventure & Doki Doki Literature Club.
translation:
吉良做了一个奇妙的梦。在梦里，他与“荒木庄”的众人一同就读于一所高中的文学部——社团名字也叫“荒木庄”。这里有傲娇的迪奥、天才科学家卡兹、青梅竹马的挚友多比欧、迪奥的头号狂热粉丝普奇、文学部部长瓦伦泰、狂野不羁的迪亚哥，以及神秘转学生透龙。随着事态渐渐失控，吉良究竟能否逃出这场荒诞的梦境？

本作是融合《JOJO的奇妙冒险》与《心跳文学部》的粉丝自制同人游戏。
